name: Stay. -Fragments of Memories-
source:
Doujin game inspired by ONE ~Kagayaku Kisetsu e~. Contains three separate stories with three different protagonists:

"Stay.": [url=/c97359]Nagamori Mizuka[/url] tries to [spoiler]cope with Kouhei's sudden disappearance[/spoiler].
"Before it turns into a memory": [url=/c97358]Kawana Misaki[/url] tries to find out what happened to [url=/c97354]Orihara Kouhei[/url], with the help of [url=/c97357]Kouzuki Mio[/url] and [url=/c97360]Miyama Yukimi[/url].
"Sweet": Orihara Kouhei and [url=/c97355]Satomura Akane[/url] enjoy their daily life as boyfriend and girlfriend.
